displayName: GHADV-2878: Apache ActiveMQ Broker, Apache ActiveMQ, Apache ActiveMQ All have an Exposure of Sensitive Information Through Metadata
description:
Apache ActiveMQ Broker, Apache ActiveMQ, Apache ActiveMQ All have an Exposure of Sensitive Information Through Metadata vulnerability

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: apache activemq broker, apache activemq, apache ac

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_other_ghadv_2878", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%apache%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%activemq%') AND "value" > 0
